Linear models of heterogeneity metrics on epigenomic features

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity_downstream.R
fit_epigenomic_models.Rd

For each metric, fit scale(metric) ~ features + covariates with features transformed by signed log1p and scaled, and width (log1p), S50 and mean_usage scaled.

Usage

fit_epigenomic_models(
  d,
  metrics,
  features,
  covariates = c("width", "S50", "mean_usage", "chr")
)

Arguments

d

Per-IZ table with the metrics, features, width, S50, mean_usage and the covariates.

metrics, features

Column names.

covariates

Covariate column names.

Value

A data.frame of feature coefficients per metric with BH FDR.
